speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the nature of your pain. Is the abdominal pain located in your right lower quadrant, and have you noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) with likely concurrent acute cystitis.

I am concerned about your sexual history and symptoms of dysuria and pain with intercourse. Please see a sexual health clinic immediately for a STI screen and treatment; I will not perform further physical exams here.
